title: FPI buying hits 5-year high in November. What's driving the $7.5 billion inflow?
summary: Foreign portfolio investors returned to the Indian equity scene with a robust investment of $7.5 billion in early November, signaling a shift after a streak of outflows. Key influences on this development included falling crude oil prices and profit-taking related to AI shares. Simultaneously, domestic institutional investors sold stocks amid rising foreign flows, indicating a divergence in market trends.

summary: Nifty closed lower at 25,144 due to rising inflation concerns and higher crude prices. The recent decline follows three consecutive days of gains and reflects profit booking by investors. title: Stocks in news: Tata Motors PV, Eicher Motors, Belrise Industries and Patanjali Foods

title: Peak repo rate pegged lower at 6%, December hike on
summary: Most economists expect the terminal, or peak, repo rate at 6%, reversing earlier projections of 6.25%. While some still see the possibility of the policy rate rising to 6.25%, they consider it a low-probability outcome that would depend entirely on incoming data.

title: RBI pushes back on easing microfinance FOIR, flags rising rates and debt risks
summary: The RBI has rejected calls to relax the 50% fixed-obligation-to-income (FOIR) limit for microfinance borrowers, warning that excluding certain loans from the calculation could understate household debt. Deputy governor Shirish Chandra Murmu said the limit should be treated as a maximum, not a lending target.
